ebenezer-arp-rock-hill-sc.assessment: Ebenezer Presbyterian Church (ARP) in Rock Hill, South Carolina has been led by Senior Pastor Rev. Dr. Matt Allison since 2015. His theological training is unusually broad: Florida Southern College (undergraduate), Columbia Theological Seminary, and Erskine Theological Seminary (the ARP seminary). Before Rock Hill, he led congregations in Florida and Georgia. ARP male-only ordination and Westminster Standards make this a clean fit with the MOOP biblical-design rubric. Green-rated orthodox Reformed option for the Rock Hill/Charlotte-south area.

ebenezer-united-methodist-church.assessment: Ebenezer UMC is a large, well-established church in Stafford with a long history. It affirms core Christian doctrines like the Trinity and salvation in Christ. However, as part of the United Methodist Church, it is aligned with a denomination that ordains women and has adopted progressive stances on human sexuality that are in conflict with biblical orthodoxy held by complementarian evangelicals. For those seeking a church that upholds male-only eldership and a traditional view of marriage and gender, this church would not be a fit. The pastor's name was not clearly identifiable from the church website or directories.

score_notes.christology: Affirms the Apostles' Creed and historic Trinitarian orthodoxy.
score_notes.scripture: UMC holds to the primacy of Scripture, but allows for tradition, experience, and reason to inform interpretation, which can sometimes soften a stance on inerrancy.
score_notes.gender: The United Methodist Church ordains women as pastors and has moved to permit LGBTQ+ ordination and same-sex marriage, which is contrary to a complementarian, traditional biblical ethic.
score_notes.leadership: As a UMC church, it does not hold to a male-only elder/pastor requirement for leadership.
score_notes.soteriology: Affirms salvation through Jesus Christ alone, consistent with historic Methodism.
score_notes.cultural: Remaining with the UMC suggests an alignment with the more progressive cultural stances of the denomination.
score_notes.mission: The church has a stated mission of outreach and bringing hope to the world.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Website indicates men's ministry is available.
score_notes.denominational: Post-2024 UMC removed all restrictions on LGBTQ+ ordination and same-sex marriage. Conservative churches departed to Global Methodist Church — those remaining are the progressive/moderate wing.
